no_business_rules_reason: CBCUS01C is a pure file-print utility: it opens the customer KSDS (CUSTFILE) for sequential input, DISPLAYs every CUSTOMER-RECORD to SYSOUT, and closes the file. Its only conditional logic is file-status handling (end of file, abend code 999 on any I/O error).

observations.text: Each customer record is displayed twice: once in 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT after a successful read and again in the main loop.
The whole CUSTOMER-RECORD, including CUST-SSN, CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID and date of birth, is written to SYSOUT unmasked.

paragraphs.logic: Displays a start banner, opens CUSTFILE, loops calling 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT until END-OF-FILE = 'Y' and displays CUSTOMER-RECORD after each successful read, then closes the file, displays an end banner and GOBACKs.
paragraphs.name: (PROCEDURE DIVISION entry)

paragraphs.logic: Reads the next CUSTFILE record into CUSTOMER-RECORD and displays it on status '00'. Status '10' sets APPL-RESULT 16 and END-OF-FILE 'Y'; any other status displays 'ERROR READING CUSTOMER FILE', the file status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 1000-CUSTFILE-GET-NEXT

paragraphs.logic: Opens CUSTFILE-FILE for input; a status other than '00' displays 'ERROR OPENING CUSTFILE', the status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN

paragraphs.logic: Closes CUSTFILE-FILE; a status other than '00' displays 'ERROR CLOSING CUSTOMER FILE', the status, and abends.
paragraphs.name: 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE

paragraphs.logic: Displays 'ABENDING PROGRAM' and calls CEE3ABD with ABCODE 999 and TIMING 0.
paragraphs.name: Z-ABEND-PROGRAM

paragraphs.logic: Formats IO-STATUS into the 4-digit IO-STATUS-04 (binary conversion of the second byte for non-numeric or '9x' statuses, otherwise zero-padded) and displays 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' with it.
paragraphs.name: Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

summary.text: CBCUS01C is a batch COBOL utility that prints the customer master file. It opens the indexed file CUSTFILE (500-byte records keyed by 9-digit customer id, layout CVCUS01Y) for sequential input, reads every record into CUSTOMER-RECORD and DISPLAYs it to SYSOUT until end of file. It writes no files. Any open, read or close error displays the file status as NNNN and abends with code 999 via CEE3ABD.
